text_block_list.text: Oh, it's almost time for training.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: I'll just organize these files first.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Excellent, that's done with. Now, what's
left?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course. I need to skim the
documents for
tomorrow's meeting.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I might as well give them a thorough
read while
I've got them...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Hm... These points could definitely be
expressed
more clearly.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I should go over these again and
trim
them down a little...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
No, I can't just leave them like this. I
should fix
this passage, at the very least!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
By the time Симболи Рудольф fixes up the

documents to her satisfaction, training
time has
already come and gone...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
